name: Imp Delivery
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
There is one more process required for Mor'zul's parchment; I need paper infused with Xorothian stardust.  And... I'm afraid I can't do that here.  I don't have the equipment!

There is an alchemy lab, however, with everything needed.  It's in the Scholomance, on the isle of Caer Darrow in the Plaguelands.

I can't make the trip, but here - take this jar.  There's an imp inside who is quite clever.  Let him out at the alchemy lab and he'll infuse the parchment.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance.  After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, good. J'eevee created the parchment. How was the Scholomance? Charming, don't you think? And the bugs there... I hear they're delicious!

Well done, adventurer, and thank you for returning my jar. I've had it for a long time... and it's not for sale!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you been to the Scholomance, adventurer? Has the imp yet infused the parchment with the stardust?

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 58 to 60, 43,675 XP in all.

quests.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Lord Banehollow
quests.objectiveText: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes. Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.

quests.name: Rage of Blood
quests.objectiveText: Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Ulathek the Traitor
quests.objectiveText: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

quests.name: Wildeyes
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

quests.name: Imp Delivery
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance.
